title: Source Candidate Preference: trusted source-finder rows beat metadata-only rows

claims.summary: The release does not claim 100/100; it targets a source-license score loss visible in the latest full ZIP/log evidence.
Source-finder ledger assembly ranks topic candidates so accessible, non-ambiguous, trust-eligible sources beat first-position metadata-only rows.
Open Library public metadata remains review-only; the patch prefers stronger candidates instead of promoting ambiguous metadata.
The regression proves an Open Library first / OpenAlex second topic exports trusted, concept-linked OpenAlex evidence.

carryForward.next: After deploy, run a fresh EduTool.dev ZIP/log audit and verify whether the source-ledger score loss improves on real output.
If a run enriches fewer than all lessons, it must retry within bounded repair budget or remain visibly caveated/blocked.
